rationale: Preserve previous X sizes and match feedback/no-feedback arms exactly using common fault records. Pilot brackets a transition-like feedback rise between .01 and .02; choose seven positive rates to support both-edge trimming and five sizes to support dropping the smallest. 500 pairs per point limits follow-up runtime using measured ~0.3 seconds per L11 pair. This is a fresh exploratory study; no pilot or historical counts enter fits.
fit_policy: Same quadratic binomial-logit primary, nu bounds .3 to 5, >=4 sizes and >=5 rates, interior optimizer, monotonicity, goodness p>=.01, exactly one common adjacent crossing cluster containing candidate, >=80% of 200 bootstrap fits usable with interior 95% intervals, and passing stable drop-smallest/narrow-both-edges/cubic/fixed-1/L sensitivities. Withhold threshold unless all pass.
comparison: Pointwise paired discordance intervals; no threshold-difference inference from separate marginal bootstraps.
